title: Harness desktop · anonymous responsiveness

panels.title: Scroll CPU cost · p50
panels.description: Aggregate CPU-side timing, not presented FPS. At least 100 frame samples per OS; empty means no data. Ten-minute uploads can arrive late.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, os_type) (increase(harness_desktop_frame_cpu_milliseconds_bucket{os_type=~"$os",host_arch=~"$arch",service_version=~"$version",harness_panes=~"$panes",harness_renderer=~"$renderer",harness_interaction="scroll"}[$__range]))) and on (os_type) (sum by (os_type) (increase(harness_desktop_frame_cpu_milliseconds_count{os_type=~"$os",host_arch=~"$arch",service_version=~"$version",harness_panes=~"$panes",harness_renderer=~"$renderer",harness_interaction="scroll"}[$__range])) >= 100)

panels.title: Scroll frame samples · selected window
panels.description: Frame counts, not people or installations. Missing platforms mean no reports, not zero latency.

description: Opt-in aggregate CPU timings for macOS, Windows and Linux. No user or installation IDs. Percentiles require 100 frame samples, not 100 people. Promote coarse OTLP resource attributes at the collector; see desktop-responsiveness.md. No hosted dashboard is deployed by this file.
